simClock.title: Encounter clock for this course
simClock.body: Results keep their clinical turnaround and every time learners see is simulated time. The scale makes the simulated clock run faster than the real one, and each cap is the longest real wait for a report: when it is reached first, the clock jumps to the report and the patient's course moves on by the same simulated time.
simClock.scale: Clock scale (simulated minutes per real minute)
simClock.scaleHint: {{min}} is real time, {{max}} the fastest. Now: 1 real minute is {{sim}} simulated minutes.
simClock.caps: Longest real wait for one report (seconds)
simClock.previewRow: clinical {{clinical}}: first report after {{first}} s, final after {{final}} s
simClock.saved: Saved. New encounters in this course use this clock.
simClock.resetDone: The course uses the AcuDx default clock again.
simClock.loadFailed: The course clock could not be loaded ({{error}}).
